Title: Projects, publications and project links

Description:
Add a `Project` model to record club projects, team members, project details, cover images and external links. Also provide fields for publications and talks.

Acceptance criteria:
- `Project` model with slug, tagline, cover image, members, topics and detail.
- API endpoints to create/list projects and link projects to members.
- Simple admin UI for featuring projects.

Notes:
- Use slug uniqueness and friendly URLs for projects.

Priority: Low
